dedupe_keys.name: cleaned datasets and analysis scripts for evs charging stations and grid impact in egypt

description: Cleaned Datasets and Analysis Scripts for EVs Charging stations and Grid Impact in Egypt is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley Data. This dataset contains cleaned and processed data used in the study of smart electric vehicle (EV) charging stations and their impact on the electrical grid in Egypt. EV charging station data were collected from PlugShare (snapshot on March 15, 2024) and underwent duplicate removal and quality assurance (QA) checks. Coverage: Egypt. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley Data. Its tags are Electrical Engineering, Electrical Mobility. The repository dates the deposit 2025; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
